Title: LSJ : Agaitas + Deal with the devil

Messages.Author: martin laganičre
Messages.Body:
If i have Agaitas and play deal with the devil , can i draw my new hand from
my prey's library or i can only replace the master card i just played and
the other cards will from my library?

Thanks ,

Martin Laganiere

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
In message <cIS0c.40232$T03.1...@wagner.videotron.net>,
"martin laganičre" <mega...@decepticons.com> mumbled something about:

>If i have Agaitas and play deal with the devil , can i draw my new hand from
>my prey's library or i can only replace the master card i just played and
>the other cards will from my library?

"Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement from
your prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in
front of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, and be played
or discarded as normal."

You draw __its replacement__ (in other words, one card) from your prey's
library, and the card effects then occur as normal (from your OWN
library).

-- Derek
